new_value: {"description":"From Mark 2026-10-21. vtc-00 VTCLivestream today models only an outbound push (streamUri/streamKey to an external platform). Add vendor- and protocol-neutral support for server-hosted one-to-many broadcast: calls stay on WebRTC/SFU; a livestream exposes one or more playback endpoints whose protocol comes from an open set (packager pipelines like HLS/DASH, WebRTC playback like WHEP, Media over QUIC, later others). No vendor names; no HLS-specific mechanisms in normative text. Design test: the model must fit at least an AWS packager pipeline, a WHEP/SFU-egress service, and a free-tools path (ffmpeg + static origin). Crate work: crate-jmap epic JMAP-po6q."}
